resources.string: Home screen. You can speak a command, scan what is ahead, read text, start walking mode, call a helper, or send an emergency alert.
Phone mode is active. Point your phone forward. I will describe nearby objects and warn you about obstacles.
Document reader. Hold the document steady. I will read text when it is clear.
Walking mode. I will give short guidance and interrupt for danger.
Emergency screen. You can call, send SMS, or share your location and latest image with a trusted contact.
Trusted helpers. Add people who can assist you through WhatsApp or Live Help.
Settings. Change language, voice, accessibility, emergency contacts, camera mode, and AI model.
Live Help. You can invite a trusted helper to see your phone camera and speak with you.
Speak a command. Use your voice to control the app hands-free.
What is ahead. Describe what is in front of you.
Read this. Read text, signs, or documents in view.
Walking mode. Continuous guidance while you walk.
Call or message a trusted helper on WhatsApp.
Start Live Help. Share a link so a trusted helper can see your camera and talk with you.
Emergency. Contact a trusted person quickly. Use with care.
Camera permission is needed for this feature.
Microphone permission is needed for voice commands and Live Help.
Location permission is needed to share your position in an emergency.
Lighting is low. Move to a brighter area if possible.
The image is blurry. Hold the phone steady and try again.
Your glasses are not connected.
Phone guidance resumed.
Opening WhatsApp to reach your helper.
Waiting for your helper to join Live Help.
Your helper joined Live Help.
Live Help failed. You can use WhatsApp instead.
Live Help ended.
Emergency alert starting. Double tap cancel to stop.
Emergency alert cancelled.
Voice Guide turned on.
Voice Guide turned off.
